translations.en: so do it as a favor to me!
When you nod your agreement,
@7rCyrus's@0r face suddenly breaks into a broad smile.
Thank goodness. I knew you'd say yes!
Apparently, there's a way to fool the curse on this city,
but it requires a ritual.
The old mage told me exactly how to perform it.
I just need you to gather the ingredients
and take me to the right place.
Apparently, the ingredients can be found in @6rDiemen Labyrinth@0r.
Um, give me a moment.
There's a fallen sign saying De Burcht,
translations.note: De Burcht is editorial Dutch place-name orthography, pending in-game sign confirmation.

translations.en: in a place that seems to have been a medicine storehouse.
I need one @3rPurple Potion@0r from there.
And a @3rRed Elixir@0r from a place called Turf.
translations.note: Turf is editorial Dutch place-name orthography; Purple Potion and Red Elixir are distinct ingredients.

translations.en: Apparently, there's a sign or something saying Turf.
translations.note: Turf is editorial Dutch place-name orthography, pending in-game sign confirmation.

translations.en: Those are the two things we need.
Whatever @7rCyrus@0r may intend,
there should be no problem if you proceed cautiously.
Why not?!
If people can escape this way,
what's the problem?!
Why are you so suspicious of me?!
Sure, you might not trust me much,
but I'm trying to do something about this too!
Damn it, why won't you understand?!
After angrily ranting at you, @7rCyrus@0r
falls into a sullen silence.
There's a favor I'd like to ask. Is that all right?
Looking even more nervous than usual, @7rCyrus@0r
approaches you, glancing around warily.
Apparently, there's a way to escape this city
without breaking the seal.
Surely there's nothing wrong
with finding a way for us and the townspeople to escape,
just in case the worst happens?
I'd like your help... What do you say?
Judging by @7rCyrus's@0r nervous behavior,
there seems to be something he is not telling you.
It really does sound like a good way out!
An old mage who's apparently been exploring
near this settlement for a long time told me. It's true!
@7rCyrus@0r does not seem to be lying.
What should you do about this request?
Whatever @7rCyrus@0r is hiding,
securing an escape route from the sealed city
does seem important.
Thank youuu!
I knew you'd get it back!
Here! This is to thank you!
From @7rFiore@0r, you received a reward of @3r60,000 G@0r.
And this is for my drinks... Waaaah!
Once I pay my tab, I'll be broke again!
Huh? Oh, the @3rCoin@0r?
Here, this old @3rCoin@0r.
@7rFiore@0r shows you the @3rCoin@0r.
It certainly looks old and well worn.
It's not enchanted, either.
It wasn't worth much when I had it appraised,
so I guess it's just something they used in this city long ago.
Well, see you around.
I'd better get back to work myself.
Heeey... Huh? You got it back already?
That was fast... Hic.
Oh, not yet...
Ahahaha! Well, do your best to get it back... Hic.
Have you decided to take the job?!
...Hic.
Please! Help me out,
and catch that bag thief for me!
At this rate, @7rBeatrix@0r is going to give me a beating!
Please, please, please! Say yes!
Yessss! That's an adventurer for you!
Always helping people in trouble!
Now, about the thief...
They headed toward @6rDiemen Labyrinth@0r.
Oh, right. All my money's in that stolen bag,
so I can't pay you unless you find it!
Besides the money... I think there was an unusual @3rCoin@0r.
I don't think it was magical, though?
translations.note: Negative recollection read as not magical, supported by ordinary coin in E1920 and no enchantment in E1897. Japanese question ending could be read differently in isolation.

context: Cyrus requests two ritual ingredients and conceals an escape plan; intoxicated Fiore later requests her stolen bag.
decisions: Control tokens remain on their source rows and in their original sequence. Genuine sentence continuations retain row boundaries; other omitted subjects are restored from scene context. Unknown historical warrior gender stays neutral. Item names follow the shared glossary; established imported prose and provenance remain intact.
